name: Denture Grant (Sainik Welfare)
benefit:
- Financial Assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided for the purchase of Denture.

- The amount is credited to the beneficiary’s Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen)/Widow of an Ex-serviceman.- The applicant should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry.- The applicant should not be a member of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS).
